power-interest-grid.why: Explicitly uses a Power × Interest grid with all four standard quadrants (Manage closely, Keep satisfied, Keep informed, Monitor) and places named stakeholders in each.

tailored-engagement.why: The detailed engagement table provides per-stakeholder breakdown of what they care about, what they need, cadence, and channel — clearly differentiated across stakeholders rather than a uniform approach.

champions-blockers.why: Dedicated sections identify specific champions and blockers with explicit reasons for each, plus concrete action plans to enlist champions and neutralize blockers.

distinct-axes.why: The output demonstrates awareness of the distinction — e.g., CEO/COO placed in Keep satisfied (high power, lower interest) vs. Design Lead in Manage closely (high power, high interest), and Monitor quadrant contains low-power/low-interest external parties.

revisit.why: A dedicated 'Revisit' section explicitly notes that stakeholder positions can shift, lists specific triggers for each stakeholder, and describes the likely directional shift in quadrant placement.
